annotations.text:
Ours: the bloom layer, the page ground, the 56px wordmark header.
Clerk's: everything inside the card. Its structure can't change — only its skin, through the appearance prop. Its strings can change, through localization.
The two washes are landing-bloom.tsx's bloom-1 and bloom-3 at scroll progress 0, placed on a diagonal to frame the card. Static: there is no scroll here to drive the drift.
Sign-up asks for email and password on one card. Sign-in is identifier-first: email, Continue, then the password step — which is what the Error artboard shows.
Clerk's own form_password_incorrect string, kept because it already reads as §5 wants. It is replaceable via localization if you'd rather it said something else.
Painted by <ClerkLoading>, not by Clerk. Its card measures 419px — the same as the sign-in card — so nothing shifts when Clerk mounts.
